lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn

variants.intro: These shelves once supplied half the coast. Now every road brings another excuse. Let us begin with enough magic to keep a worker alive.
variants.life: The growers left good roots in the ground. They need a safe place to work and someone to show that the next harvest will reach us.
variants.fire: The goblins charge the miners for entering their own workings. Coal is piling up behind three barricades. The toll ends today.
variants.water: Water is standing over the gathering beds, while the lower channels are dry. Mend the watercourse and the cutters can work again.
variants.earth: The potters have Clay and Peat. Their cart has been turned back twice. Bring them here alive, and every mixer in the village can start again.
variants.school: We have ingredients. We do not yet have enough people who can make anything with them. Help me teach three new hands.
variants.wind: The seed growers and reed cutters blame one another for ruined loads. Their harvests are good; their drying stations are not.
variants.magic: The refining apparatus leaks. I can mend its joints with a stabilizer, but the only clean binding agent comes from an intact cave-spider gland.
variants.death: One bitter shipment frightened the marsh gatherers away. Someone changed the labels, then spread the story that every Death Essence was poison.
variants.frost: The cold-storage works have stopped. The stock will spoil before another cart arrives unless we restore circulation and protect the workers.
variants.finale: Every route we reopened is being watched. They mean to burn the workshop and every shipment beside it. This time we have workers, supplies, and a plan.

lines.text: Let us put these shelves back to work.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn

variants.intro: Leave The True Note and walk to the coastal practice camp in Landfall. The quest marker is at (273, 124). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.life: Leave The True Note and find the Sage beds west of the city in Landfall. The quest marker is at (64, 249). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.fire: Leave The True Note and find the flint workings west of Landfall city. Start the raid there when ready. The quest marker is at (51, 216). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.water: Follow the Landfall coast to the sluice worksite marked on your map. The quest marker is at (279, 112). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.earth: Meet the potters at the loading point on the coastal road in Landfall. Load their cart there to begin the delivery. The quest marker is at (268, 128). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.school: Meet Mara, Tovin and Sela at the coastal teaching bench in Landfall. The quest marker is at (273, 124). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.wind: Walk to the coastal drying station in Landfall and meet the seed growers and reed cutters. The quest marker is at (270, 126). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.magic: Meet the refiners at the resin station on the Landfall coast. Begin the spider hunt there. The quest marker is at (273, 115). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.death: Meet the marsh gatherers at their southern collection station in Landfall. The quest marker is at (146, 382). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.frost: Meet the cold-storage workers at the coastal works in Landfall. The quest marker is at (279, 112). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.
variants.finale: Meet the trained crew at the coastal workshop receiving yard in Landfall. Begin the defense when your party is ready. The quest marker is at (273, 124). Travel there when you are ready; your quest instructions list the work. Return here afterward for your reward.

lines.text: Check the supply ledger before setting out.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn

variants.intro: You can mend, aim, recover and mix. Now we can do more than ration what remains.
variants.life: The growers have a protected station and a buyer they can trust. There will be Life Essence on my shelf again.
variants.fire: No toll, no stolen loads. Coal and Flint can reach the mixers, and Fire Essence can reach the shelf.
variants.water: The channels run clear. The crew has its beds back, and our Water Essence supply has returned.
variants.earth: The potters' cart has arrived. This is what a supply line looks like: people reaching home with something useful.
variants.school: Three learners, three useful batches. The next shipment no longer depends on one tired pair of hands.
variants.wind: Dry seed, sound reeds, and people finally talking to one another. Wind Essence joins the shelf.
variants.magic: The apparatus holds a true note again. Keep this enriched essence as thanks; ordinary mixes still have their ordinary rare-result chances.
variants.death: A name is not a verdict. The marsh workers have a safe process, and Death Essence has an honest place on the shelf.
variants.frost: The cold holds, and the workers can promise a shipment instead of an apology. Frost Essence is available again.
variants.finale: Listen. Mortars, wheels, voices, and no empty shelves. We did not merely save a shipment. We taught this place how to keep going.

lines.text: This supply can be relied on again.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: There is one more gift: an enriched essence from my reserve. Choose the one that will serve your next journey.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Listen to the problem before you choose the advice.

lines.speaker: Apprentice

variants.mara: I brought Sage and Reed. They look right, but I cannot make Life Essence.
variants.tovin: I have the right ingredients and tool. I skipped breakfast, and now I cannot keep mixing.
variants.sela: I used a bowl to crush the herbs. Surely any bowl works like a Mortar and Pestle?

lines.text: Can you help me find the mistake?

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: A successful mixture needs the right ingredients, a proper tool, and food. Try a real batch at your bench.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: And one enriched essence, from my own reserve. Choose the one that will serve your next journey.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: These shelves will stay open to you. Come back for supply contracts, and bring news of the roads.

lines.speaker: Mara Vale
lines.text: You made it. Let us put these supplies back on the road.

variants.intro:
Open Magic. Heal mends you; aim Heal Target at me. Restore Ether spends Water Essence; Fire Bolt needs a hostile target. Check each cast's cost.

Open Mixing, then Alchemy. Two Sage and one Hearthroot make Life Essence. Keep your Mortar and Pestle in your pack and eat first. The practice station provides safe injuries and replacement ingredients after a critical loss.

Complete all four casts and three Life Essence mixes, then report to Ilka at her shop.
variants.life:
Sage and Hearthroot make Life Essence: two Sage, one Hearthroot. Keep enough for your ten mixes; put the growers' share in the collection chest. Use the gatherers' caches for storage and mixing.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.fire:
A direct assault is quicker. The miners' side approach lets you silence their signal first. Both roads end with the workers owning their coal and flint again.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.water:
Work from the upper gate down. The bypass takes fewer repairs, but brings a smaller shipment. Kelp and Watercress make Water Essence; it fuels Restore Ether and joins Life Essence in Heal Target.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.earth:
Stay with the cart. It stops for enemies, damage, and anyone left behind. Heal Mara if she is hurt; repair the cart at a safe halt. Choose the main road for speed or the longer sheltered route.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.school:
Mara keeps choosing the wrong ingredients. Tovin's hands shake because he has not eaten. Sela borrowed a bowl and thought it would replace a Mortar and Pestle. Listen before you offer advice.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.wind:
Keep fresh reeds away from damp seed sacks. Repair the racks, set the vanes, and choose between a sheltered site and a larger exposed station.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.magic:
Track the spiders near the resin station. Damaged glands still teach us where to look; after twelve eligible specimens you will have a usable one. Mix the stabilizer, then make Magic Essence from Lotus and Resin.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.death:
Compare the labels with the samples. Toadstool and Thistle are useful when handled properly. We can inspect every batch, or follow the false labels back to the saboteurs.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.frost:
Set the intake first, then seal the containers. A trained villager will handle Frost production; your personal Frost mixing assignment opens at Potion level sixteen.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.
variants.finale:
Choose where the trained crew will stand. Hold the receiving yard, help the wounded, and stop their quartermaster before he reaches the workshop.

Your quest instructions list each task. When the work is done, walk back to Ilka at The True Note for your reward.

lines.text: This supply can be relied on again. Let us return to The True Note.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: These shelves once supplied half the coast, but now I cannot even keep enough stocked to supply our patrols. Could you help us re-establish our supply lines?

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Thank you for your help, here is 500 gold coins for your work. Next we will need to gather ingredients for fire essences to supply our offensive magic. Please gather 100 coal and 50 flint and bring them to me so we can mix a new supply of fire essences. I have marked the mines on your map. You will need a pickaxe to harvest these, so please take these with you.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Thank you for your help, here is 500 gold coins for your work. The last basic essence we need to prepare is water essence. Please gather 100 kelp and 50 watercress and bring them to me so we can mix a new supply of water essences. You will need to travel east to Reedfall to gather these. I have marked their location on your map.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Thank you for gathering the ingredients. Keep them in your pack: we will use them to mix the essences. Your harvesting reward is recorded.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Thank you â€” that is a sound practice batch. You have earned 500 gold and the lesson experience. The shop stock will remain reserved until we secure the gathering crews and their supply route.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: I am glad you were able to mix them. Please bring them to me in your inventory.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Next we will need to teach you the basics of magic so that you can help defend our patrols. Go to Ostrid Hollin at the temple and she will teach you.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: We need all the help we can get to protect the city. Let's go into the temple to practice.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: There are three basic spells that you will need to know to help our patrols. Open the spell window and we will get started.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: There are many different spells available for advanced mages, but for now we will focus on how to heal yourself, how to damage an enemy with fire, and how to restore your ether when you are low. Many spells have different targeting options. You see for heal four options are available. From left to right you can target yourself, another individual target, your allies, or an area of effect. The ether, reagent costs, and recommended magic levels are higher for targeting others than yourself.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: Healing yourself costs 5 ether and 1 life essence. The amount of health you heal will scale with your magic level and your magic defense attribute. You can cast heal by clicking in this window or using it from the quickspell bar if you have it assigned. Here are some life essences for you to practice with. Try casting heal on yourself.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: Next let's learn to cast fire bolt on your opponents. Open the spell window.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: Here you see there are only two options for offensive magic: one target or an area of effect. Casting fire bolt on one target costs 5 ether and 1 fire essence. The amount of damage your spell will do scales with your magic level, your magic offense attribute, and any elemental weaknesses or resistances on the target. Try casting fire bolt on the practice dummy over there.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: Note that your ether is going down as we are casting spells. You can also regain ether with magic. Open the spell window.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: The gain ether spell can be used when you are not engaged in combat to restore ether over time. The amount of ether you gain scales with your magic level and magic defense attribute. Restoring your own ether costs 1 water essence and no ether. Try casting gain ether on yourself.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: Gain Ether is also called Restore Ether. Taking damage or entering melee ends its recovery. You can cast at range, but stay clear of incoming attacks while recovering.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: Meet me in the sparring arena through the doorway on the right. Let's spar with magic to see what you have learned. Keep your health and ether up, and try to take me down with your fire bolt.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: This is a private, nonlethal practice bout. I will stop if either of us falls. Talk to me to review the lesson or retry.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: Steady yourself. There is no shame in practicing again. Keep your health up with Heal, strike me with Fire Bolt, and make room to recover ether. Talk to me when you are ready to try again.

lines.speaker: Ostrid Hollin
lines.text: Excellent work. You should be ready to defend our caravans. Go back to Ilka when you are ready to help. Here are a few more essences for you to use to continue practicing.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Thank you. Let's mix these into life essences to provide to the guards defending our caravans. Open the mixing window and mix 25 life essences. Here are a few Potions of Feasting and mortar and pestles you can use.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Keep gathering the marked ingredients, or finish your 25 successful mixes. Bring your work back to me here at The True Note. Your quest instructions show your remaining tasks.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Thank you. Let's mix these into fire essences to provide our mages with reagents for offensive magic. Open the mixing window and mix 25 fire essences. Here are a few Potions of Feasting and mortar and pestles you can use.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Keep gathering the marked ingredients, or finish your 25 successful mixes. Bring your work back to me here at The True Note. Your quest instructions show your remaining tasks.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Thank you. Let's mix these into water essences to provide our mages with reagents for defensive magic. Open the mixing window and mix 25 water essences. Here are a few Potions of Feasting and mortar and pestles you can use.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Keep gathering the marked ingredients, or finish your 25 successful mixes. Bring your work back to me here at The True Note. Your quest instructions show your remaining tasks.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Four villagers have offered to gather our next shipment. Goblins have been coming out of the Old Warren to drive them off. Will you keep the crew safe?

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: The crew needs 10,000 Sage, then 5,000 Hearthroot. They will harvest and carry the loads themselves. Protect all four. If someone falls, use Heal Target on her; she will get back to work. Go to the marked beds when you are ready. I have put a guard allowance in your pack or personal storage. These practice supplies do not reopen the shop stock.

lines.speaker: Fenna Ash
lines.text: We will harvest the Sage and carry full bags to that store. Watch the approach from the Old Warren. The goblins have been coming south out of its mouth.

lines.speaker: Fenna Ash
lines.text: Our four health bars tell you who needs help. Heal Target gets a fallen worker back on her feet. The shipment counts only when a bag reaches storage. You can pause from the quest window; nobody keeps harvesting while you are away.

lines.speaker: Fenna Ash
lines.text: All 10,000 Sage are in storage. Keep the bags here; the next crew will turn them into essences. Meet us at the Hearthroot patch marked on your map. We only need 5,000 roots for the same number of mixes.

lines.speaker: Fenna Ash
lines.text: Same work, new ground. We need 5,000 Hearthroot in storage. The goblins still come out of the Old Warren, but now their route leads east toward these beds. Watch the western approach.

lines.speaker: Fenna Ash
lines.text: That is the last of the Hearthroot. Every goblin came from the same tunnels. Tell Ilka what we saw. A full store will not help if the next gathering crew cannot reach these beds.

measure.shelves.growers.report_crew.title: A trail back to the Warren

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Ten thousand Sage and five thousand Hearthroot, safely stored. But the crew saw every raider coming from the Old Warren. We have enough ingredients; we still need a road that stays safe.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: You have earned your pay for protecting the crew. There is another job when you are ready: go into the Old Warren and stop whoever is sending those raiders. Our Life Essence stock will open once that route is safe.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Every raider came from the Old Warren. Goblins and their wolves have a leader down there. Break their hold before another gathering crew takes the road.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Enter the Old Warren west of town. Your party can join at the entrance. Follow the goblin tracks and wolf prints into the deeper western caves and confront Grask, the orc directing the raids.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Goblin tracks, wolf prints, and heavy boots. Someone larger is directing these raids. The tunnels bend deeper to the west. We should keep an eye on the side caves.

lines.speaker: Grask, the Burrow-Taker
lines.text: Little harvesters, little guards. Every sack on that road belongs to Grask. You came all this way to become another missing shipment?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Your goblins will not touch the gathering crews again.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: The raids end here. The crew can reach the beds again. We should tell Ilka the route is safe.

lines.speaker: Ilka Tarn
lines.text: Grask is gone, the crew has a safe route, and we can finally promise a steady supply. Life Essence is now available here. Fire and Water must wait until we secure their own gathering crews.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We were overwhelmed. We can regroup and try again, or leave for now. What should we do?
